what: On the pad (giant wordmark), each time the cursor moves 150px the next sticker is thrown from 50px up-left of the cursor at the cursor speed (screen coordinate difference between frames more than 15ms apart × 3, ±300px). It is clamped to stay on screen (width − 200, height − 150), flies over .5s cubic-bezier(.39,.575,.565,1) while growing from .3 to 1 scale, rests .2s, then falls screen height + 300px down over .4s cubic-bezier(.4,0,1,1). Stickers are used in rotation, and a sticker still in flight is skipped (that turn rests).

options.step: Cursor travel distance to emit one sticker (px), default 150
options.offset: Distance to dodge up-left from the cursor (px), default 50
options.w: Sticker width used to clip so it stays within the screen, default 200

note: drop-badge-trail pops out while being pushed down at the same time (elastic·back.in) and floats up a clone — this part reuses N stickers in place, throws them first at cursor speed, then rests and drops them. On devices without a hand (touch) and with reduced motion, the stickers are hidden (the consuming css may set them up elsewhere). The panel is overflow: hidden so dropped stickers get clipped.

from.where: All pages Footer .g-footer__logo — original framer sequence [x,y .5 [.39,.575,.565,1]] [scale .3→1 at <] [y → innerHeight+300 .4 [.4,0,1,1] at +0.2]
